title: Auto-save case/data
notes: There is no working syntax: in start.sh.template (2025 R1) it is recorded that `data-frequency 5000` aborts the journal, and `case-frequency` expects a list, not a number. In 2026 R1 the TUI help says: case-frequency is a preference, data-frequency is a numeric increment. The valid case-frequency values are not listed → requires_verification; verify only on a scratch case (an auto-save abort stops the whole batch run).
